IMPORTANCE, the new ones: 'Pick this one' (pressing the strip casts exactly as pressing the card does), the card itself, 'Next two' (a real BUTTON.btn.prim -> the next pair with both scores hidden again), 'or press Enter' (same), the 'Why?' toggle (flips label, +124px), the rank numeral (still silent - cursor pointer, NO title attribute, no label; it is a second surface for the toggle beside it, which is the fixer's decision, but the fixer's note that 'it carries a title' is not true), the trail crumbs (SPAN role=button tabindex=0, underlined, navigate on click). Round one found 42 control kinds on Make and 14 on Importance; on Make all 42 now carry a label or a tooltip AND a visible consequence except the Description field, which the fixer left on purpose. On Importance, 15 of 16 kinds carry a visible label - the rank numeral is the one that does not.

RUN CONDITIONS AND WHAT I DID NOT REPORT. (a) Two screenshots (p10, p16) show short runs of the middle pane's body text painted orange. It is not in the DOM: a sweep of every leaf element inside .paging-make-live for a computed colour anywhere near --prim returned ONE element, the eyebrow, at rgb(106,106,106). (c) Round one's judge pair was a question against a question; mine was a question against a CAVEAT of a different question ('What color is it?' vs 'Carfax misses unreported accidents'). Comparing a question to a warning about another question is a data-model question, not a defect of the screen, so it is here and not in the ten - but nothing on the cards says which kind each is except an unlabelled icon.

### What still misleads a newcomer, ranked

1. **Make · the sample eyebrow** — it says *sample text — the content word (Article) draws this until you add a block*, so you add a block, and the eyebrow becomes *and the content word — Article*: the word **sample** is gone and 300 words about a product called Northwind sit under your own title with nothing saying they are not yours. Five more, one `log` line each in this task: the SKIN row's TYPE SIZE select **overruns its card by 14px at 1280** (pre-existing, round one's own png shows it) · the two **white circles** before CONTENT COLOUR / PAGE COLOUR still read as unchecked radios · Importance prints the **five judgments under the caveat**, not under the toggle that opened them ([png](08-trace-rows-under-the-caveat-1280.png)) · the judge screen prints *"Saved to disk…"* and *"Buying a used car"* **twice on one screen** at every width ([png](09-two-saved-to-disk-1280.png)) · **renaming a page does not move its address**, and the two disagreeing strings sit four lines apart.
